name: Bylous
message: 「However, this has given me a new reason to live」

name: Bylous
message: 「However, the next time we meet... I swear I will defeat you both」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure make big promises without thinking twice」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope. Because as long as I'm with you, Macaron, I feel like we can get through anything」

name: Bylous
message: 「Big talk. Still, I wouldn't expect any less from the Demon Lord I acknowledge」

name: Macaron
message: 「We won, so celebrate with everything you've got!」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right! Today is the fun-filled Holy Night Festival!」

name: Helena
message: 「All that's left is to let loose and go completely wild!」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, you're the one who needs to hold back...」

name: Helena
message: 「Booo! Come on, it's a festival, so why not!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please save your sleep-talking for when you are actually asleep」

name: Helena
message: 「Then at least let me give this to our two Demon Lords!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Together we make a proper Demon Lord, right... That goes without saying!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but thank you very much」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hell yeah! The great me is gonna bury my face in Ria-chan's boobs to my heart's content!」

name: Synn
message: 「Never drops his guard for a second, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even after the world's at peace, danger's still lurking everywhere, I guess」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah, the Holy Night Festival is supposed to be way more wonderful than this...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte. Shall we go check on how Azel-san is doing?」

name: Pasta
message: 「...Well then, Pasta is going to head off now, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Let's go around the Holy Night Festival together!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'll pass, nya. This is goodbye for you guys and me, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm sure we'll see Pasta again too, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「We're friends, after all. Of course we will!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan, there are food stalls over here」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister, please allow me to accompany you as well!」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister, I shall accompany thee as well!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, let's go over that way」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, we're gonna check out the other side first」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, what was that you wanted to talk about earlier?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Regarding that matter, I believe it would be best if someone even more knowledgeable than I were to join us」

name: Helena
message: 「We've had a little Peeping Tom lurking around the whole time, after all~」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh my, oh my... So the lovely young ladies saw right through me, did they?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You bastard, sneaking around and hiding again...」

name: Helena
message: 「So anyway, to be blunt, this is about little Macaron...」

name: Melilot
message: 「This man has been tailing her with a full grasp of the situation」

name: Melphas
message: 「I was merely watching over our beloved princess, nothing more」

name: Melphas
message: 「A princess who likely carries the bloodline of the branch family...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I haven't got the slightest clue what you're talking about...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, are you planning to play dumb?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, how about having the Great Sage listen to a bit of our idle chatter?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It won't take up too much of your time」

name: Melphas
message: 「Pardon me, then. This is merely a story that was passed down to me, mind you...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Long ago, so that his bloodline would never die out, the First Demon Lord is said to have divided his descendants into a main family line and a branch family line」

name: Helena
message: 「To deal with Re-Crea more reliably, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, according to historical records, throughout history thus far, the branch family line has never stepped onto the main stage...」

name: Melphas
message: 「And over the course of many long years, those who gradually forgot the very reason for their existence are none other than the princess's bloodline」

name: Melphas
message: 「After all, up until now, the main family clan alone was able to handle Re-Crea」

name: Melilot
message: 「During any single Re-Crea, only one Demon Lord manifests their power...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, Miss Macaron's innate potential still manifested to that extent.」

name: Helena
message: 「And thanks to that, we were saved this time.」

name: Helena
message: 「Once the Re-Crea passes, the Demon Lord's power will simply subside, after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. I kept this from Bylous, however...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakuya was by no means in peak condition back then.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, it remains a fact that the two of them surpassed Bylous in power.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Truly a miracle wrought by love, wouldn't you say?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In short, Miss Macaron may be a Demon Lord descending from a branch family.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is the hypothesis I have formed based on my texts and Melphas's information.」

name: Helena
message: 「What is the real truth of the matter, Great Sage?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Who knows? That was way too long ago--I've completely forgotten!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you have forgotten, then it cannot be helped. What a shame.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yet leaving it as such has a certain charm to it, does it not?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Above all, a woman adorned in secrets is a thing of beauty. It will only polish the princess's allure all the more.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait a sec, why the hell are you even getting mixed up in this conversation...?」

name: Melphas
message: 「I too have spent quite some time in high society, you see.」

name: Melphas
message: 「And I happened to have a slight connection with the Kingdom of Ratafia as well.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though I do question the propriety of a noble wandering about so aimlessly.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, in the end, we never did confirm whether Macaron-chan is the true Demon Lord」

name: Melilot
message: 「At this point, perhaps that no longer matters...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Power surpassing both the will of God and a Demon World berserker, is it...」

name: Helena
message: 「To those two, something like that isn't all that important...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh... Acting all lovey-dovey suits 'em way better」

name: Macaron
message: 「We really did it... we fulfilled our goal, didn't we...」

name: Synn
message: 「We protected our sparkling school life, world peace, and everyone's smiles」

name: Macaron
message: 「I felt so happy and relieved, and when I thought about how it's all over...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then, somehow, I just ended up like this!」
I pull Macaron's shoulders in tight against me
I gently stroke her cute head as she lets out faint hiccuping sobs.

name: Synn
message: 「If they're happy tears, you can cry as much as you want.」
When I suddenly look up at the sky
Before I knew it, tiny sparkles had begun dancing down...
She softly reaches a finger out toward the dancing ice fairies...
She pulls her hand back with a little flinch.

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm fine! 'Cause you're with me, big bro!」
Having wiped the corners of her eyes, Macaron is already back to her usual self.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that's the music from the dance party.」

name: Synn
message: 「They're holding it over by the tower right now」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. There's even a pretty tree right here」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, just what you'd expect from a princess」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Still, I guess there's one thing I'm grateful for. To Mama and Papa」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because thanks to them, I get to dance with you, big brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe. Well then, wait just a bit」
Having been brought out at some point without me noticing, the usual tent was right there.
Beneath the wintry sky, I wait a while for Macaron, who had slipped inside.
And then, how many flakes of powder snow had I counted when...
It shone brighter than crystals of silver.
A faint flush colored her pure white skin.

name: Macaron
message: 「Just in case something like this happened, you know... hehe\s03」
A presence that put even the snow to shame, brightly illuminating the evening dusk.
The nobility, cheerfulness, and innocence hidden within her.
They melted the frozen winter air, took hold of it, and transformed it into a world for the two of them alone.

name: Macaron
message: 「Maybe all the hard work I put into making it was worth it♪」
The sight of her standing there was unbearably dazzling.
Even her usually innocent smile looked more mature than ever.
Just speaking her name made my heart race uncontrollably.

name: Macaron
message: 「That's the first time you've ever called me beautiful」

name: Synn
message: 「Truth is, there's so much more I want to say, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「I just don't know how to put it into words so it really gets across...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Just hearing you compliment me is more than enough, Big Brother」
Scattering a bright, cheerful smile, she gracefully extended her hand.
More delicate than ever, shining far brighter than usual.
Yet that overflowing gentleness was still the Macaron I loved.
I hesitate, wondering if it's really okay for me to touch such a wonderful Girl.
Yet facing each other, we're already a single existence.
Our joined hands feel as though they were always meant to be like this.
After that, we're just our usual selves...
Pulled around completely at Macaron's mercy, I stumble through the falling snow.

name: Macaron
message: 「Hehehe, look, look, I told you that's not how you do it♪」
Puffs of white breath bounce softly into the air, slowly melting away into transparency.
Still, no matter how much she drags me around, I never let go of her hand.

name: Synn
message: 「This isn't the end or anything, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「We still have tons of things left to start together, don't we」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as the two of us are together, I'm sure anything we do will be fun」

name: Synn
message: 「So, let's stay by each other's side forever」

name: Synn
message: 「Just like our hands holding onto each other right now」

name: Synn
message: 「I love you, Macaron! Stay by my side forever!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because I love you too, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I love you more than anyone else ever could!」
Holding each other's hands even tighter, squeezing them even closer.
This ball for just the two of us won't end until the waltz fades away.
I swear upon everything in this world, this is what I truly believe.
That no matter how much time passes, no matter where we go, we'll always be together.
